sentences.text: Birth of the Dragon is a 2016 American biopic martial arts action film directed by George Nolfi and written by Christopher Wilkinson and Stephen J. Rivele .	George Nolfi	George Nolfi	Christopher Wilkinson	Christopher Wilkinson	biopic	Biographical film	martial arts	Martial arts film	action film	action film
The film stars Philip Ng , Xia Yu , and Billy Magnussen .	Philip Ng	Philip Ng	Xia Yu	Xia Yu (actor)	Billy Magnussen	Billy Magnussen

The true story revolves around the young martial artist Bruce Lee , who challenges kung fu master Wong Jack Man in 1965 in San Francisco .	Bruce Lee	Bruce Lee	Wong Jack Man	Wong Jack Man	San Francisco	San Francisco
Principal photography began on November 17 , 2015 in Vancouver .	Principal photography	Principal photography	Vancouver	Vancouver
It was selected to be screened in the Special Presentations section at the 2016 Toronto International Film Festival .	2016 Toronto International Film Festival	2016 Toronto International Film Festival
The film is scheduled to be released on August 25 , 2017 by BH Tilt and WWE Studios .	BH Tilt	Blumhouse Productions	WWE Studios	WWE Studios
